about: One damaged workspace draft per place a registry tool threw on it, found by restoring every draft-backed field of every scene from hostile values at the base of this fix, then cut to the fields needed to throw. `threw` is what the base build threw and where; `fix` is the normaliser (or the platform check) that now restores it. toolDraftDamagedRestore.test.mjs opens each one. All content is synthetic.
